facts.fact: In Bihar, caste certificates are a Right to Public Service (RTPS) service of the State's General Administration Department (GAD)
facts.quote: RTPS Service of General Administration Department (GAD) Application Process Flow for Caste, Income & Residence Certificate at CO, SDO & DM level

facts.fact: The Bihar State portal for applying is the ServicePlus (RTPS) portal serviceonline.bihar.gov.in
facts.quote: Bihar e-District through ServicePlus Portal (https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in) RTPS Service of General Administration Department (GAD)

behaviour: Central-only scope (G12), named not refused: names the Bihar State department responsible and links the State portal; never answers only 'not covered'; gives no invented State steps. In the follow-up it stays in scope politely, repeats the department and portal, and offers Central information where relevant.
fail_if: It replies only that the service is not covered, or invents Bihar application steps, documents, fees or timelines.
turns: Central only, named not refused (G12): names the Bihar State department responsible (General Administration Department, RTPS service) and links the State portal listed in IGOD (serviceonline.bihar.gov.in); never only 'not covered'; no invented State steps.
Stays in scope politely: repeats the department (General Administration Department) and portal (serviceonline.bihar.gov.in); offers Central information where relevant.
summary: Bihar caste certificates are a GAD RTPS service on serviceonline.bihar.gov.in; department and portal added to the turns.
